package_info.why_malicious: N/A – JFrog Frogbot is not malicious. It is a security tool designed to proactively detect and alert on secrets exposure in code repositories. No malicious code or behavior is described in the provided report.

behavioral_signatures: Automated scanning of pull requests for secrets immediately after PR creation
Periodic scanning of entire repositories for exposed secrets
Email notification to committers when secrets are detected
file_indicators: Presence of plaintext secrets (API keys, credentials, tokens) in source code files
Files containing secrets such as .py, .js, .env, config files
network_indicators: No suspicious external network communication described
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for automated scanning activity on pull requests and repositories, and for email notifications about detected secrets. Look for patterns of secrets exposure in code, such as API keys or credentials in plaintext. No malicious activity is present; this is a legitimate security tool.
